title: Seasonal Drinks
description: Limited-time flavors from the current Moof menu.

items.name: Strawberry Royal Milk Pudding Matcha / Hojicha
items.description: Strawberry puree and milk pudding layered with matcha or hojicha.
items.signature: milk pudding is set in-house daily, then layered under mori matcha or hojicha so each sip moves from creamy to grassy.

items.name: Black Sesame Matcha / Hojicha
items.description: Black sesame paste and syrup with matcha or hojicha.
items.signature: black sesame paste is toasted and ground in-house, whisked into shiran matcha for a nutty finish that never turns gritty.

review.quote: nutty, smooth, and not too sweet

items.name: Pickled Ume & Plum Iced Tea
items.description: Bright ume and plum iced tea with a tart finish.
items.signature: ume plums are pickled in-house and steeped cold, no matcha at all, for the one bright, tart pour on the board.
